text: Crelan is a 100% cooperative Belgian bank: the cooperative fund CrelanCo (SC/CV) is its 100% shareholder, and more than 291,000 customers are cooperative shareholders.
short: Crelan is wholly owned by the cooperative CrelanCo.

source.name: Crelan: 'Les actionnaires de Crelan' (the shareholders of Crelan)
source.quote: La solide caisse coopérative CrelanCo SC est actionnaire de Crelan à 100%.
source.note: Same page: 'Crelan est aussi une banque coopérative à part entière.' and more than 291,000 customers are cooperative shareholders. Dutch version: https://www.crelan.be/nl/cooperanten/artikel/de-aandeelhouders-van-crelan
